# OLagoon Knowledge Graph
> OLagoon is a drop-stitch inflatable pool knowledge system organized as a machine-readable knowledge graph.

## Definition
OLagoon designs professional-grade drop-stitch inflatable pools — family pools, plunge pools, and pool accessories.

## Core Concepts
- Inflatable Pool: Portable drop-stitch pool that inflates into a rigid, self-supported swim zone — engineered like a yacht deck with 20 cm walls and yacht-grade seams
- Steel Frame Pool: Seasonal pool built from a painted steel pipe frame with a hanging vinyl liner — the common mid-market alternative to drop-stitch pools
- Hard-Sided Pool: Permanent or semi-permanent pools with rigid resin, composite, or panel walls — typically requiring ground works, professional installation, and permits
- Small Backyard Plunge: A compact rigid pool for tight spaces — a couple with a small townhouse yard gets a real place to cool off after work, without permanent construction
- Family Backyard Fun: A full-size pool the whole family can actually swim in — a 3m x 2m swim area with rigid 20 cm drop-stitch walls, clean water, and easy entry for little ones
- Entertaining & Hosting: A statement lagoon for gatherings — a showpiece 5m x 2
- Drop-Stitch 2.0 Core: Two PVC layers joined by 16,000 polyester threads per square meter — inflating to a flat, rigid panel that gives pool walls yacht-deck stiffness at a fraction of the weight
- RF Welding: Radio-frequency welding fuses PVC seams at the molecular level — combined with double-needle stitching for seams that hold pressure season after season
- Military-Grade PVC: UV-stabilized, puncture-resistant PVC membrane with multiple reinforcement layers — the same fabric family used in military inflatable boats, applied to pool walls and floors
- High-Pressure Structure: The engineering principle behind rigid inflatable pools: a drop-stitch chamber held at 10-15 PSI operating pressure (18 PSI rated) turns air and fabric into a load-bearing structure
- Pool Accessories: The OLagoon accessory ecosystem: sand filter pump for clear water, thermal cover for warm and clean water, ground mat for base protection, and entry steps for safe access

## Relations
- Drop-stitch pools turn small backyards into private plunge spots
- A rigid inflatable pool gives the whole family a real place to swim all summer
- A statement lagoon pool anchors garden parties and weekend gatherings
- The Drop-Stitch 2.0 core is what makes an inflatable pool rigid enough to swim in
- RF-welded seams keep pool walls airtight season after season
- Military-grade PVC gives pool walls their puncture and UV resistance
- High-pressure rigidity is only possible with a drop-stitch core
- Filter pumps, covers, mats, and steps complete the pool experience
- A drop-stitch pool needs no frame assembly and packs flat, unlike rust-prone steel frame pools
- Inflatable pools deliver hard-sided swimming feel without construction or permits

OLagoon is a backyard pool knowledge system focused on drop-stitch inflatable pools, pool filtration, and water care. It structures pool equipment as an interconnected ontology of categories, technologies, and use cases with AI-verified content completeness.
